# Frozen SW2MuJoCo v2 CAD fixture

Generated with the pre-rename production SW2URDF.dll and d19fbb3 test code. Contains four links/three joints, reference coordinates, sites, collision/contact, connect, motor, IMU, constant force, spring and custom solver. CAD files are immutable golden inputs; tests must copy them into build/ before opening/saving. No user CAD files were used.

The earlier JSON/XML fixture in tests/compatibility/sw2mujoco_v2 remains frozen independently, including its renamed/deleted identity coverage.
